dressing.name: The Ashen Crypt
dressing.overview: A single burial chamber beneath a ruined chapel. Cold, close. The stair they came down is south; an open door leads north.
dressing.sensory: Air like a held breath. The braziers hiss. Every sound arrives a half-second late, as if the room is deciding whether to allow it.

propDescriptions.stair-south: The stair the party came down, open to the grey light of the ruin above.
propDescriptions.brazier-east: A second brazier, matching the first, its flame guttering as if in a draught you cannot feel.
propDescriptions.candles-north: A huddle of candles on the north wall, burned down to nubs.
propDescriptions.banner-east: A faded banner on the east wall, the device worn to a stain.
propDescriptions.fox: A stone fox, sitting, watching the north door. One ear is broken off.
propDescriptions.barrel-west: A warped barrel shoved against the west wall, its hoops rusted shut.
propDescriptions.crate-east: A splintered crate, empty except for straw gone to dust.
propDescriptions.lantern-north: A standing lantern, unlit, between the east brazier and the north wall.
propDescriptions.pillar-west: A squat pillar, its base ringed with old wax.
propDescriptions.skull-north: A yellowed skull on the flagstones, missing the jaw.
propDescriptions.sarcophagus: A stone sarcophagus on a low dais. The lid is carved with a robed figure whose face has been deliberately chiselled away. The seam is scored with fresh scratches, as though something has worked at it from beneath.
propDescriptions.horse: A horse statue, smaller than life, its rider long since knocked away.
propDescriptions.brazier-west: An iron brazier burning low and green. It gives heat but no smoke.
propDescriptions.door-north: A slab door on the north wall, banded in tarnished iron. It stands open.
propDescriptions.alcove: A shallow alcove behind a displaced stone, holding a clay votive lamp and a bundle of grave-cloth gone black with age.
propDescriptions.shrine-north: A small shrine jammed into the north-east corner, its niche empty.
propDescriptions.bucket-west: An iron bucket beside the west brazier, dry.
propDescriptions.chair-north: A wooden chair facing the north door, as if someone had been waiting.
propDescriptions.coffin-corner: A plain coffin stood on end in the corner, the lid still nailed.
propDescriptions.vase-east: A tall vase, chipped at the lip, holding nothing but grit.
propDescriptions.pot-west: A clay pot, the kind grave-goods come in, its mouth sealed with wax.
propDescriptions.pillar-east: A squat pillar. Something has scratched a tally into it — eleven marks, the last one incomplete.
propDescriptions.rubble: A spill of fallen masonry where the ceiling has given way.
propDescriptions.ribcage-east: A ribcage, animal or child, it is hard to say, slumped against the east wall.
propDescriptions.cobweb-west: A thick cobweb spanning the west wall, grey with dust.

text: Cold stone and the smell of ancient tallow hit your throat as you step off the bottom stair.
Twin iron braziers hiss quietly, washing the vault in a sickly green light that catches on the defaced effigy atop the central sarcophagus.
Across the chamber, an iron-banded door stands open to the dark.
I inspect the sarcophagus in the center

The fresh scratches along the rim are clear enough, but you cannot tell what made them or if the heavy lid can even be shifted from here.
The dead weight of the slab yields nothing to your prodding.
The effigy's face is chiselled away, leaving a cold, chiselled scar.

dressing.name: The Long Gallery
dressing.overview: A processional gallery, long and narrow, running north from the crypt stair. Four pillars line the aisle. An open doorway at the far end continues north.
dressing.sensory: Dry where the crypt was damp, and much colder. Dust hangs in the air where the ceiling has come down. Footsteps carry the whole length and come back.

propDescriptions.niche: A niche behind a facing stone, at knee height. It holds a stack of six clay tokens, each stamped with the same procession as the far pillars.
propDescriptions.door-north: An open doorway at the head of the gallery. Nothing bars it.
propDescriptions.pillar-near-west: A fluted pillar, first of a line of four. Something has been chiselled off it at shoulder height, thoroughly, leaving a pale scar.
propDescriptions.pillar-far-east: The fourth. Its figures walk south too, and the last of them has no head.
propDescriptions.brazier-head: A cold brazier at the head of the gallery, choked with grey ash. Whatever burned here burned out a long time before the green fires downstairs were lit.
propDescriptions.ceiling-fall: A cone of fallen ceiling, tiles and mortar, with the dust long settled into it.
propDescriptions.pillar-near-east: Its partner across the aisle, scarred in the same place and the same way.
propDescriptions.pillar-far-west: The third pillar. This one still carries its carving: a procession of small robed figures, all walking south.
propDescriptions.door-south: The slab door back to the crypt, standing open.

text: The damp air of the crypt gives way to a dry, biting cold as your boots crunch onto the stone floor of the gallery.
Four fluted pillars march north into the gloom toward an open portal, flanking a mound of fallen ceiling that lies grey with old dust.
Down the aisle, far beyond the reach of your torchlight, something shifts against the masonry and falls dead silent.
I check the pillars and the ceiling above, trying to assess if it's safe to proceed forward, or will it collapse on me?

name: roll_check
message: perception check, DC 15. Rolled 10 +3 = 13 — FAILURE. Narrate this outcome and commit to it.

text: You crane your neck, lifting the torch high toward the cracked ribs of the vaulted ceiling.
Thick shadows pool in the deep fissures above, masking where solid mortar ends and loose tile hangs ready to give way.
Running a hand along the near pillar's hacked stone tells you nothing of the load it bears, leaving you blind to whether the next heavy tread will bring the gallery down.
You lifted the torch high toward the cracked ceiling; thick shadows pool in the fissures, masking where solid mortar ends and loose tile hangs ready to give way.

dressing.name: The Chapel
dressing.overview: A chapel cut into the stone, narrower than the gallery. A shrine stands in the west aisle with a small reliquary before it. Sconces line the walls, cold. An open door north, an open door south.
dressing.sensory: Wax and old incense. The air is still. When someone moves, the cold sconces seem to listen.

propDescriptions.reliquary: A small iron-bound reliquary, set before the shrine. The latch yields to a touch.
propDescriptions.niche: A shallow niche behind the shrine, holding a folded strip of cloth and a cracked votive.
propDescriptions.door-north: An open doorway north. Nothing bars it.
propDescriptions.banner-east: A faded chapel banner, the saint's face washed out.
propDescriptions.pillar-north-east: Its partner toward the north door, the carving worn to a suggestion of wings.
propDescriptions.chair: A wooden chair facing the shrine, as if someone had been at prayer.
propDescriptions.lantern: A standing lantern, unlit, by the north-east corner.
propDescriptions.shrine: A shrine in the west aisle, its niche empty except for a smear of old wax.
propDescriptions.cobweb: A cobweb spanning the west wall, grey with chapel dust.
propDescriptions.door-south: The doorway back to the gallery, standing open.
propDescriptions.candles-west: A huddle of unlit candles on the north-west wall.

text: You step through the open doorway into the still, dead air of the chapel, smelling old tallow and bitter incense.
The low gutter of your torch barely reaches the stone shrine in the west aisle, where an iron-bound reliquary sits silent on the paving.
Across the nave, cold wall sconces and a washed-out funeral banner seem to wait for your next breath.
Hmm this feels like a trap, I wonder
The silence in the room sits heavy, unbroken by any scrape of iron or hiss of saltpetre. Your guttering torch throws long, trembling shadows behind the reliquary and the empty chair facing it.
Neither tripwire nor dropped counterweight catches your eye across the dusty flags.
The silence in the room is heavy and unbroken by any scrape of iron or hiss of saltpetre.

The long aisle lies empty before you, the cone of fallen ceiling and the scarred pillars standing just as you left them in the chill dust. Only the open niche in the western wall remains bare to show you were ever here.
You step back down into the crypt, where the two braziers still hiss and throw their sickly green glare across the flags.
At the foot of the carved dais, Vessk lies where you left him, limp and stiffening in his filth.
But above the crackle of the unnatural fire, something else is moving—close, and deliberate, pacing in the dark just beyond your sight.

text: The low ceiling presses down with the rank smell of wet paper and old wood, your failing torch barely picking out the cracked flags ahead.
Dead center in the room, two wiry goblins caked in pale grave-dust freeze over their notched blades, eyes reflecting the dim amber light.
Both doors stand open behind and ahead of them, but neither scavenger moves to yield the way.

text: The first goblin darts in, but skids hard on the damp flags and nearly drives its notched blade into its own shin.
The second lunges right behind it, striking high, but the iron passes wide through empty air with a dry whistle.

Your blade crashes down hard, shearing through leather and bone to drop the goblin flat onto the cracked flags. It spills sideways into the pale dust without a sound, leaving only its companion hissing in the torchlight.
The surviving goblin lunges forward, but its foot slips on the blood-greased flags.
Its notched shortsword skitters wildly across empty air, throwing the creature off balance and nearly tumbling it into the dirt.
Your blade takes the remaining goblin full in the collar, driving it violently to the flags.
The creature twitches once in the pale dust and goes entirely still.

dressing.name: The Vault
dressing.overview: The last chamber. Dark. A gold chest on the west side, a stag on the east, and the open door they came through south. There is no door further on.
dressing.sensory: Still air, colder than the undercroft. Metal and dust. Their own breathing is loud.

propDescriptions.skull: A skull on the flags, the jaw still attached.
propDescriptions.door-south: The doorway back to the undercroft, standing open.
propDescriptions.gold-chest: A gold-bound chest, heavier than the reliquary and bright even in this dark. The latch yields.
propDescriptions.niche: A niche behind the chest, empty except for a ring of dust where something sat.
propDescriptions.candles: A pair of candles on the north wall, never lit.
propDescriptions.stag: A stone stag, smaller than life, watching the door they came through.

text: The vault opens cold and silent before you, the bitter stink of old metal and dry stone hanging thick in the air.
Across the flags, a small stone stag watches the doorway from the eastern shadows, while a gold-bound chest gleams dully along the far western wall.
Between you and the back of the chamber stands a hulking figure in rusted plate, its notched longsword already clearing its scabbard with a sharp scrape.
Iron plates grind and rattle as Brakk lurches forward across the flags to close the gap.
The notched blade whistles through the dark in a heavy, lateral sweep, cutting only the cold air inches short of your chest.
The rusted longsword crashes through your guard, the notched iron shearing deep into meat and bone with a sickening crack.
Your legs fold beneath the crushing weight, dumping you hard onto the frozen flags as the vault swims and goes black. Beside your slack fingers, the guttering torch rolls away and dies in the dust.
